text:
nina v: starting a soft-window rollout for ff `smart-route-v1`. plan: 0% -> 1% -> 7% -> 25% over ~35m. runbook pinned: https://confluence.redwood/KB/smart-route-v1
otto p: ack. primary gates: p95 latency, error-rate, and routing hit-rate. rollback thresholds: p95 +18% for 5m OR errors >1.4x baseline.
devops-bot: enqueue deploy job 6006 (image rwd/smart-route:v1-20260326) by nina v. dry-run OK.
release-bot: release note stub ready; will add pinned-fallback instructions and rollback snippet.
nina v: pin fallback config: `rwdctl config set routing.fallback v0 --pin` so we can revert quickly. otto p: done.
devops-bot: applying feature flag smart-route-v1 -> 1% (cohort sampling).
otto p: watching infra metrics. p95 flat, small p99 jitter. starting quick eval set for the cohort.
sre-night: oncall overnight, watching autopause alerts. set an autopause rule: p95 delta 22% for 3m.
nina v: holding 12m at 1%. will move to 7% if green.
devops-bot: ramp to 7% applied. cohorts updated.
otto p: noticing a subset of long-context requests with token-gen latency up ~15%. not yet at threshold but flagged. rerunning long-context eval.
release-bot: draft updated: include note about long-context observation and the pinned fallback.
sre-night: spotted one router pod with increased cache churn; autoscaler added a replica. logs: https://logs.redwood/internal/6006/router-3
ina v: do not rollback. prepare a micro-patch: reduce cache retention for v1 via image rwd/smart-route:v1-20260326a and canary it to router-3.
devops-bot: canary image swap initiated on router-3.
otto p: patched pod stable. cache churn down. long-context latency trending toward baseline.
nina v: proceeding to 25% now, but enable targeted throttle for long-context heavy cohorts to limit exposure: `rwdctl ff tweak smart-route-v1 --long-context-throttle 0.6 --cohort-min 10`
devops-bot: feature flag smart-route-v1 -> 25% applied. cohort tweaks applied.
otto p: after tweak p95 long-context reduced; overall p95 +6%, error-rate steady. all within thresholds.
sre-night: autopause remains configured. attaching automated rollback snippet to runbook: `rwdctl ff set smart-route-v1 0 --reason "auto-pause" && rwdctl config unpin routing.fallback`
nina v: good job. I'll add a short note to the release page and mark rollout as LIVE but under long-context watch for 24hrs.
release-bot: rollout job 6006 status: LIVE @25% (long-context throttle enabled). link: https://release.redwood/status/6006
oto p: tiny typo in logs channel name earlier — fixed. :grimace:
sre-night: will keep an eye overnight. ping me if any autopause triggers.
nina v: thanks team. will follow up with perf traces and eval outputs in the AM. :eyes:
